q2_gaps: extent / course verb of a linear thing ('the path runs along X', 'the road follows the river'): the bare-position route names only lie / sit / stand / hang / lean / perch / rest, so whether 'runs along' mints an event or takes the entity-attached position atom is undetermined

a relational part-noun of a place ('the outer edge of the village'): the genitive part/component test points to PartOf while the 'a place inside a place is LocatedIn, never PartOf' geography rule points to LocatedIn, and the relational-noun parenthetical ('a tributary of the river') does not settle which side an edge-of-a-place falls on
notes: Name/type split, outer_edge decomposition (positional modifier exposed), and the entity-attached (Along ...) head all follow the instruction set; no tense atom is correct for a present-tense position clause.
